verdict.rationale: GitHub documents GitHub Actions as its own feature for automating and executing workflows in a repository, and it is backed by CI/CD. That is the core of rule-based automation. However, the evidence never states that users define rules or triggers that fire on specific events. missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-based triggers (e.g., on push/PR/issue events), user-defined rule/condition syntax, examples of event→action configuration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository with GitHub Actions.
Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD.
